Clear removes a task from the repository. It exits 1 if there is no such
task.

Usage:
  agent task clear <name> [flags]

Examples:
  agent task clear research-auth

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for clear

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
